narr: A storm system moved into the area on the morning of the May 9, producing widespread heavy rain and some flash flooding through the morning of May 10.
ev: Streets and yards were flooded in neighborhoods near the Hardy Toll Rd at Mesquite due to heavy rainfall.
The intersection of US-59 and Tidwell Rd was flooded by heavy rain and made impassable.
Streets and homes were flooded across the Boca Chica Subdivision along County Road 473.
lsr: FLOODING OF STREETS, YARDS AND CLOSE TO HOMES EAST OF THE HARDY TOLL RD AT MESQUITE.
